tasks.build: deno task build:sidecar && deno task check && deno run -A npm:vite@latest build
tasks.check: deno run -A npm:@sveltejs/kit sync && deno run -A npm:svelte-check --threshold error
tasks.check:watch: deno run -A npm:@sveltejs/kit@latest sync && deno run -A npm:svelte-check@latest --watch
tasks.sync:force: rm -rf node_modules .svelte-kit build deno.lock && deno cache --reload src/lib/api.ts && deno run -A npm:@sveltejs/kit sync
tasks.test: deno task test:unit && deno task test:e2e
tasks.test:e2e: deno task bddgen && deno run -A npm:playwright@latest test
